feeds.title: Vegan Runner Eats
feeds.description: Join the journey to better health and fitness following a plant-strong vegan diet! Fun, tips, recipes

feeds.title: Vegan Muscle and Fitness
feeds.description: Owners of Richmond, Virginia's only plant-based personal training studio, Root Force Personal Training, the pair seeks to promote a fit and active plant-powered lifestyle and shatter the perception that strength and athleticism can't be achieved with a plant-based diet.

feeds.title: JustFit Blog
feeds.description: JustFit is one-on-one and online personal training by Justine Swenson, a vegan-certified personal trainer and yoga instructor. She loves to educate, research, and provide her clients with tools to help them succeed. Also trying to find ways that they can enjoy their routine and look forward to their workouts is so fun. Helping people reach their goals and realize how good a healthy lifestyle feels is what it's all about for her.

feeds.title: Daniel Welstead Blog
feeds.description: Daniel Welstead is a highly experienced vegan personal trainer in Sevenoaks that offers mobile at-home personal training services. With his expert personal training experience, and knowledge as a former professional chef, mindfulness, and vegan nutrition coach, he will be the last health and fitness professional you will need to help achieve your goals.

feeds.title: Steve Pilot Fitness Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Steve Pilot. 12 years ago I decided to turn vegan! Since then my life has changed immeasurably in many different aspects. My mission is simple - to positively influence people's lives - whether that be through sharing my fitness journey, my business, or my spirituality.

feeds.title: Dan Rémi Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Rémi, founder of My Vegan Personal Trainer. We help vegans & aspiring vegans live a fit plant-based lifestyle via online personal training, with a holistic and evidence-based approach. We will transform you from being insecure about whether you are missing essential nutrients, to knowing everything you need to thrive on a vegan diet.

feeds.title: Vegan Liftz Blog
feeds.description: Vegan Liftz is a team of diverse individuals striving to provide you with the best quality information on supplements, health, and overall lifestyle topics. With years of experience in vegan fitness and nutrition, here at Vegan Liftz, the team believes that being vegan can be tasty, exciting, and enjoyable. Vegan Liftz has set out time to research foods, exercise equipment, and more that are all vegan-based.

feeds.title: Sexy Fit Vegan Blog
feeds.description: Vegan Fitness Expert Ella Magers shares going vegan tips for a healthy, sexy fit body without harming animals! Vegan Diet Plan | Vegan For Beginners

feeds.title: FitVegans.com Blog
feeds.description: Here you will find content that will center around nutrition (a whole food plant-based diet) and fitness. You'll learn how to optimize your digestive system, how to remove processed foods from your nutrition - and the results you could get, and plant-based foods and their performance and health powers. The mission of FitVegans.com is to make fitness results simple & predictable - while advancing the transition to a sustainable & ethical food system.

feeds.title: VegNews.com » Fitness
feeds.description: From vegan fitness know-how to everything you need to know about plant-based nutrition, VegNews is the world's #1 source for all things vegan. The country's best-selling plant-based magazine, every issue of VegNews is packed with today's best vegan lifestyle content from food and fashion to travel, celebrity interviews, and beauty.
